item.title: Grant Thornton, UB Athletics, Caribbean Music Awards
item.ns0:title: Grant Thornton, UB Athletics, Caribbean Music Awards
item.description:
Tonight on Our News Weekend, major global accounting firm Grant Thornton officially returns to The Bahamas after seven years, bringing new opportunities for young Bahamians under local leadership. A newly launched civic initiative titled "Beyond the Polls" aims to boost community engagement and combat youth voter apathy, while telecommunications provider ALIV expands its investment in Exuma's youth and infrastructure. Plus, we take an inside look at the rising national pride surrounding University of The Bahamas athletics and bring you exclusive red-carpet coverage from the Caribbean Music Awards in Trinidad and Tobago. Tune in for these top stories, your weekend sports roundup, and the complete weather forecast.
